name: 27402-loradecode-qwen3moe30b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node, driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one engine, one card, no sharding.
architecture: Sparse MoE decoder (Qwen3MoeForCausalLM), 48 layers, hidden 2048, 128 experts with 8 active per token, moe_intermediate_size 768, 32 query heads over 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, bfloat16, ~30.5B params (~57 GiB).
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=24, bounded at 320 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, no tools: fixed-shape random-token requests, 2048 prompt tokens and exactly 1024 output tokens, both pinned min=max. The output length is exact (`max_tokens` with `ignore_eos`), `request_format: plain` so the wire prompt is the declared 2048 tokens with no chat template prepended, and decoding is greedy (temperature 0.0). Every request carries the adapter; nothing runs on the bare checkpoint.
purpose: A LoRA-customized 30-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts writing assistant generating 1024-token replies from 2048-token prompts, 24 concurrent streams, single GPU.
launch:
# Engine launch config for 27402-loradecode-qwen3moe30b-1gpu. Every key goes straight into
# AsyncEngineArgs; the interpreter that carries the pinned engine is named by configs/env.yaml.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
enable-lora: true
max-loras: 1
# FOLLOWS THE SOURCE'S SERVE LINE (`--max-lora-rank=64`), NOT the substituted adapter's own r=8.
# Rank is the N dimension of the shrink GEMM and the K dimension of the expand GEMM -- the
# kernels this item measures are sized by it, and `lora_shrink_op.py` grids on
# `triton.cdiv(N, BLOCK_N)` off `lora_a_weights[0].shape[-2]`. At 8 the problem is eight times
# narrower than the one the source measured. The r=8 adapter zero-pads into the slot.
# It is not free: the per-expert stacks are `max_loras x 128 experts x rank x {2048,768}` in six
# tensors over 48 layers, so rank 64 costs 6.19 GiB against 0.77 GiB. That comes out of the KV
# pool, and `scenario.json` `streams` was re-derived from what is left -- see the note there.
max-lora-rank: 64
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-seqs: 128
# Pinned. An in-process engine is built with UsageContext.ENGINE_CONTEXT, which is in neither
# per-context table, so an unpinned run falls through to 2048.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-model-len: 4096
# Above the engine's 0.90 default: ~57 GiB of bf16 weights on an 80 GB card leaves little else.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.93
dtype: bfloat16
